# SEO GEO AEO Audit

`seo-geo-aeo-audit` · v1.0.1 · Diagnose · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/seo-geo-aeo-audit/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How ready is this page to rank in search, be cited by AI engines and win direct answers, and what should we fix first?

**Inputs:** A URL (or page HTML/source), and access to fetch the page, its robots.txt, sitemap, and llms.txt

**Output:** A 0–100 readiness score across Technical, On-Page, AEO, GEO, and Authority, a letter grade, and a prioritized fix list

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill seo-geo-aeo-audit`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/seo-geo-aeo-audit/resources/score.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/seo-geo-aeo-audit/resources/score.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It only scores the pass, partial or fail results it is given. It does not fetch or inspect the page, so the score is as good as the audit against the rubric.
- Omitted or misspelled check names count as fail with no warning, and unrecognised JSON returns 0/100, grade F, rather than an error. Check every check name was read.
- It measures readiness, not traffic or citations. The GEO checks score whether claims are checkable and do not predict a lift.
- FAQPage schema and llms.txt still earn points though the skill calls them hygiene, not Google levers, so the score can rise with no change in search visibility.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the site confirms the rendering check used the crawler's view of the page (for example curl -A GPTBot) and spot-checks the failing items before fixes are prioritised. Pair the score with analytics for outcomes.
